# Copilot Instructions

This project is a UI for a full-stack Twitter clone built with Next.js, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. It includes features like user authentication, tweet posting, and a responsive design.

## Code Reference Guidance

Always refer to the code from the following repository for implementation details and best practices:

- [safak/x-clone-ui (completed branch)](https://github.com/safak/x-clone-ui/tree/completed)

The reference repository is a completed version of the UI and should be used to guide your development.

### How to Use

1. When implementing new features or fixing bugs, check the reference repository for code samples and patterns.
2. For UI components, layouts, and styling, use the reference repo for best practices.
3. For authentication, API integration, and state management, follow the approaches used in the reference repo.

### Example Prompts

- "Show me how the sidebar is implemented in safak/x-clone-ui (completed branch)."
- "Fetch the code for the tweet post component from the reference repo."
- "Compare the layout.tsx structure with the completed branch in safak/x-clone-ui."
